pk.context: 20 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: It inhibits factor Xa without a cofactor, and its 20 mg tablet is a dark red triangle.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is about 66% fasted at 20 mg, and food raises it. Protein binding is 92% to 95%, and clearance is mainly oxidation and hydrolysis, with unchanged drug also excreted in urine.
A pure single enantiomer of molecular weight 435.89, practically insoluble in water.
Approved under an NDA, as 2.5, 10, 15 and 20 mg tablets and as granules for oral suspension.

Boxed warnings: premature stopping raises thrombotic risk, and spinal or epidural hematoma. Contraindicated with active pathological bleeding or severe hypersensitivity; bleeding is the commonest reaction.
Reducing stroke risk in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation; treating and preventing deep vein and pulmonary clots; and cutting major cardiovascular events in coronary artery disease.
It selectively inhibits factor Xa without a cofactor, reducing thrombin generation; it has no direct effect on platelets.
The generic name begins with R and has eleven letters.
